subject: Pilot keepalive ask — adapter schema regression blocking integration
messages:
From: Sam Roy <sam.roy@orbitco.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Integration blocker: adapter failing after schema bump — need pilot runway

Marcus / Monica,

Quick note from our side — the adapter your team provided started failing during our staging run when our payment-events schema rolled from v1.3 -> v1.4 over the weekend. The change is small (nullable field + nested metadata) but the adapter throws a validation error and then times out. Our engs estimate this will take 7–10 business days to fully patch, test, and re-run the QA matrix because it hit three downstream services.

We were planning to complete the pilot this week and flip the integration to production by EoM. With the current regression we need more time and a little sandbox headroom to finish the rework. Can Redwood extend our pilot window by two weeks and add a small sandbox credit top-up (tokens) so our engineers can continue testing without interruption?

Attached: error_log.txt (snippet), screenshot of the adapter error, a short breakdown of the two failing calls.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Roy
Staff Engineer — Platform
OrbitCo
platformops@orbitco.com

Attachment: error_log.txt (text, 28 KB)
Attachment: adapter-failure-screenshot.png (png, 420 KB)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Sam Roy <sam.roy@orbitco.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration blocker: adapter failing after schema bump — need pilot runway

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads-up and the logs. Sorry you hit this at such a late stage in the pilot.

Short answer: yes, we can propose a 2-week pilot extension and approve a sandbox token top-up pending a brief mutual action plan (MAP) so we can track deliverables and timing. To move quickly, can you confirm these three items?

1) Target extension period: +14 days from your current pilot end (confirm date).
2) Token top-up amount: do you want a conservative 150k-token sandbox bump or something smaller?
3) Approved rollback path: are you able to run against the previous schema (v1.3) while we ship a patch, or do you need the new schema in staging to validate other flows?

If you send the answers and a quick bullet MAP I’ll route this through our pilot credits approval stream and share a draft DocuSign for the extension terms. I’ve attached a MAP draft you can edit. Karthik, could you and your team take a look at the logs Sam attached and flag whether a hotfix or config change would be sufficient?

I can be available for a 20-minute sync this afternoon if that helps.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (docx, 18 KB)

From: Sam Roy <sam.roy@orbitco.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration blocker: adapter failing after schema bump — need pilot runway

Thanks Marcus — answers below and I’ve updated the MAP draft inline. Short version: we need the new schema active in staging because other teams are already exercising v1.4; we can’t fall back to v1.3 without coordination that would take longer.

1) Extension: +14 days from 2025-11-16 (current pilot ends 2025-11-16) — so new target 2025-11-30.
2) Tokens: 150,000 sandbox tokens should be sufficient for the next round of regression tests and load validation.
3) Rollback path: not feasible — other dependent systems will break. So a patch is required.

MAP (high level):
- Day 0–1: Redwood engineering triage + access to our staging logs (we’ve shared service keys with your engs).
- Day 2–5: Patch development and unit tests.
- Day 6–8: Integration test and smoke test in staging (v1.4).
- Day 9–10: Release candidate & run the acceptance suite.
- Day 11–14: Buffer for rollback / clean-up and production cutover planning.

We attached a short error trace and a GIF of the failure on our side. If you can provision the token bump and confirm the extension in writing, we’ll keep the engineering work on track and prioritize the acceptance tests.

Appreciate the help.

— Sam
Sam Roy
Staff Engineer — Platform
OrbitCo

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, Sam Roy <sam.roy@orbitco.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Integration blocker: adapter failing after schema bump — need pilot runway

Sam / Marcus — quick update from engineering after reviewing the logs and the replay steps. Root cause: our adapter's strict payload validation didn't account for the new nullable metadata node. Fix is straightforward (relax validation + add a targeted test case), estimate 3 business days to implement + 2 days for staging verification.

From the approval side, I’m green to propose the +14 day extension and the 150k-token sandbox top-up to Finance/CS. Marcus, please attach the MAP and the updated error bundle to the HubSpot deal and include the DocuSign link so I can kick off an internal expense exception if needed.

If Finance needs a written justification I can produce a short engineering note describing the regression, the patch, and the verification plan.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SWE, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
